assets.name: Long Wang Village Day
assets.description: A quiet rural Chinese village street on an overcast day, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a pale grey-white overcast sky band, a row of small single-storey stone and timber village houses with sloped tile roofs standing shoulder to shoulder all at the same height, a narrow flat dirt path running edge to edge across the middle, and a flat grassy ground strip across the bottom. Every roofline and house front perfectly horizontal and unbroken from the left edge to the right edge, no receding side wall visible. Muted rural palette of grey stone, weathered brown timber and pale earth tones.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng thấy ảnh quá phức tạp (nhiều nhà, có lớp nhà phía sau). Đã tạo lại đơn giản hơn dưới tên "Long Wang Village Day V2" — chỉ vài căn nhà nằm ngang mặt đường, không có nhà phía sau. Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Long Wang Village Night
assets.description: The same quiet rural Chinese village street at night, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a dark navy night sky band with a few small pale stars, a row of small single-storey stone and timber village houses with sloped tile roofs standing shoulder to shoulder all at the same height, one or two windows glowing with warm dim lantern light, a narrow flat dirt path running edge to edge across the middle, and a flat dark ground strip across the bottom. Every roofline perfectly horizontal and unbroken edge to edge. Dark cold nighttime palette of deep navy, charcoal and warm dim yellow window light.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): cùng lý do với "Long Wang Village Day" — đã tạo lại đơn giản hơn dưới tên "Long Wang Village Night V2". Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Long Wang Village Day V2
assets.description: A quiet rural Chinese village street on an overcast day, drawn like a very simple theatre backdrop. Only two or three single-storey stone and timber houses stand side by side in a single row, their front walls facing directly toward the viewer, each with a plain sloped tile roof, all at exactly the same height. Nothing stands behind the houses at all — no second row of buildings, no distant rooftops, just plain empty pale grey-white overcast sky directly above the roofline. A wide flat dirt path fills most of the frame in front of the houses, running edge to edge, with a narrow flat grassy ground strip along the very bottom. Every roofline and house front perfectly horizontal and unbroken from the left edge to the right edge. Muted rural palette of grey stone, weathered brown timber and pale earth tones.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng so sánh với bản Night V2 và thấy dãy nhà KHÔNG tràn hết chiều ngang khung hình (còn hở đất/trời 2 bên), khác hẳn bản Night V2 tràn kín. Đã tạo lại dưới tên "Long Wang Village Day V3" ép rõ tràn hết cạnh-tới-cạnh. Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

Only two or three single-storey stone and timber houses stand side by side in a single row, their front walls facing directly toward the viewer, each with a plain sloped tile roof, all at exactly the same height, one or two windows glowing with warm dim lantern light. assets.name: Village Market
assets.description: A small outdoor rural market street, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a pale overcast sky band, a row of simple wooden market stalls with striped fabric awnings all standing at the same height along one side, each stall holding a few simple woven baskets of produce, a flat dirt path strip running edge to edge, and a flat ground strip across the bottom. Every stall front perfectly horizontal and unbroken edge to edge, no receding side wall. Muted daytime palette of warm brown wood, faded red and cream awning stripes, pale earth tones.

assets.name: Foggy Mountain Trail
assets.description: A narrow dirt trail winding through a misty mountainside. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of pale grey-white fog completely swallowing the distant hills, midground layer of tall bare tree trunks fading into the fog, foreground layer of a narrow dirt trail bordered by low scrubby bushes running across the bottom of the frame. Dense heavy fog rolling low across the whole scene, muted cold palette of pale grey, muted green and soft white mist.

assets.name: Long Wang 18 Lakes Hillside
assets.description: A scenic hillside overlook above a chain of small lakes, a popular tourist spot. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a series of pale blue-grey lakes nestled between low misty hills, midground layer of a grassy hillside slope with a few scattered rocks, foreground layer of a flat grassy hilltop clearing spanning the bottom of the frame. Soft overcast palette of pale blue, muted green and grey mist.

assets.name: Long Wang 18 Lakes Opposite Hilltop
assets.description: A second scenic hilltop at the same lake district, the viewpoint looking across toward a neighbouring hill. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of the same chain of pale blue-grey lakes nestled between low misty hills, midground layer of one distinct rounded grassy hill standing clearly apart across a shallow empty dip of lower ground, its bare grassy crown plainly visible, foreground layer of a flat grassy hilltop clearing spanning the bottom of the frame. Same soft overcast palette of pale blue, muted green and grey mist as the other hillside background, with the same simple scattered rock and grass shapes. The far hill must be clearly separated from the near foreground hilltop by the visible dip of lower ground between them, so the two hilltops plainly read as two separate places a short distance apart.
assets.notes: Bối cảnh ĐỐI DIỆN của 'Long Wang 18 Lakes Hillside' — cùng địa điểm nhưng là ngọn đồi A Fei ĐỨNG, nhìn sang đồi bên kia (nơi nhóm 5 người đứng). Tạo ra để tách câu kịch bản 'spotted a group ... then drew closer' thành 2 shot có vị trí không gian khác nhau (shot/reverse-shot) thay vì gộp làm 1 ảnh — xem RUNBOOK mục 8.2i.

assets.name: Misty Forest Interior
assets.description: Deep inside a dense misty forest. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of tall tree trunks fading into thick pale fog, midground layer of a dense cluster of bare and leafy tree trunks of varying width, foreground layer of a flat forest floor covered in fallen leaves and low undergrowth spanning the bottom of the frame. Heavy fog drifting between the trees, muted cold palette of deep green, grey-brown bark and pale mist.

Warm muted palette of cream and brown wood tones.

assets.name: Forest Ridge Overlook

Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a dense forest treeline filling the top of the frame with dark green treetops on brown trunks, midground layer of a tall eroded dirt and clay embankment face running the full width of the frame with varied earthy brown tones and shadowed crevices, foreground layer of low green bushes and drifting pale mist along the very bottom edge. Muted earthy palette of brown clay, dark green foliage and soft white mist.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng thấy ảnh thiếu đường đi. Đã tạo lại có thêm đường mòn dưới tên "Forest Ridge Overlook V2". Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Forest Waterfall Meadow

Cool palette of grey stone, pale blue water and soft green grass.

assets.name: Forest Clearing With Boulder

Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a dense forest treeline filling the upper portion of the frame with dark green treetops, brown trunks and darker green bushes along the tree line, and a flat dirt clearing floor strip across the bottom, no sky visible. Sitting on the left side of the clearing floor, in front of the treeline, one cluster of two or three large rounded grey boulders half-covered in patches of moss, big enough for a person to sit down on. The rest of the clearing floor stays open and empty. Muted palette of deep green foliage, brown dirt and grey stone.

Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a dense forest treeline filling the upper portion of the frame, dark navy night sky with a few small pale stars just visible through gaps between the treetops, and a flat dark dirt clearing floor strip across the bottom, no other sky visible. Sitting on the left side of the clearing floor, in front of the treeline, one cluster of two or three large rounded grey boulders half-covered in patches of moss, big enough for a person to sit down on, same shape and position as the day version. The rest of the clearing floor stays open and empty. Dark cold nighttime palette of deep navy, charcoal and muted moonlit blue-grey.

assets.name: Prison Cell 1983
assets.description: A narrow prison cell interior from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale grey concrete ceiling band across the top, a plain pale grey concrete back wall filling the middle with one small square barred window set high in it, a plain metal bunk bed with two flat mattress slabs standing against the left side and a plain steel washbasin block against the right side, and a plain flat grey concrete floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The bunk bed and the washbasin stand ON the floor strip and must touch it, not float. Cold palette of pale grey and washed blue, plain flat institutional daylight.

assets.name: Cemetery Funeral Ground
assets.description: A quiet flat cemetery on open ground. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a low row of dark green trees all at the same height along the far edge under a plain overcast pale grey sky, midground layer of a row of plain simple rectangular headstones all at the same height standing side by side, foreground layer of a plain flat green grass strip spanning the bottom of the frame with one plain rectangular open grave pit and one plain low mound of brown earth beside it. Muted overcast palette of grey, dark green and brown, daytime.

assets.name: Bob House Exterior
assets.description: The front of a small two-storey American suburban house from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale grey overcast sky band across the top, a plain pitched dark grey roof band, a plain pale yellow clapboard front wall filling the middle with one plain white front door at the centre and one plain square window on each side, a plain low wooden porch step, and a plain flat concrete path with a plain green lawn strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The house wall must be scaled and positioned to completely fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge, with absolutely no gap of open lawn or empty sky at either side edge beside the house. Plain flat daylight, daytime.

assets.name: Bob Bathroom
assets.description: A small American bathroom from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain pale mint-green tiled wall filling the middle with one large plain rectangular mirror mounted at the centre and a plain white sink basin directly below the mirror, a plain white bathtub standing along the right side, and a plain flat white tiled floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The mirror must be drawn as one plain empty rectangle with a flat pale silver surface and absolutely nothing reflected in it. The sink and the bathtub stand ON the floor strip and must touch it. Plain flat indoor lighting, daytime.
assets.notes: Gương CỐ Ý để trống hoàn toàn — để cảnh ghép sau đặt 'Crowned Old Man' vào đúng khung gương đó. LỖI THỜI (2026-08-11): gương nằm giữa khung nên bị nhân vật đứng chắn, và mặt gương phẳng không đọc ra là kính. Thay bằng 'Bob Bathroom V2'.

assets.name: Bob Bathroom V2
assets.description: A small American bathroom from 1983 seen straight on, with every fixture pushed to the SIDES so the middle of the room stays open. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain pale mint-green wall filling the middle, and a plain flat white tiled floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. On the LEFT side of the frame: one LARGE plain rectangular mirror mounted on the wall in a plain dark grey frame, tall enough to hold a person's head and shoulders, with a plain white pedestal sink standing on the floor directly below it. The mirror is drawn as a plain EMPTY rectangle with a flat pale blue-white surface crossed by exactly two thin pale white diagonal streak shapes running corner to corner, so it plainly reads as a glass mirror — and absolutely nothing else inside it, no face, no figure, no reflection of the room. On the RIGHT edge of the frame: one plain white bathtub standing on the floor. The whole MIDDLE of the room, both the wall and the floor, is left completely clear and empty. Plain flat indoor lighting, daytime.
assets.notes: Thay 'Bob Bathroom'. Sửa 2 lỗi người dùng chỉ ra trên ảnh thật (2026-08-11): (1) gương+bồn rửa ở GIỮA khung nên nhân vật đứng chắn mất gương, không còn chỗ ghép mặt ông nội ở hậu kỳ → dạt hẳn sang TRÁI, chừa giữa trống; (2) gương ra màu xám phẳng không đọc ra là gương → thêm ĐÚNG 2 vệt sáng chéo làm tín hiệu mặt kính. (Lần tạo đầu bị assertAssetNamed báo nhầm là hỏng tên; tra tay xác nhận có thật nên đặt success, KHÔNG tạo lại.) LỖI THỜI (2026-08-11): vẫn là 1 mặt tường phẳng, gương treo ở mép trái của tường sau chứ không phải trên tường bên. Thay bằng 'Bob Bathroom V3'.

assets.name: Bob Bathroom V3
assets.description: A small American bathroom from 1983, drawn as a CORNER of the room built from exactly TWO flat wall panels meeting along ONE single vertical line. The LEFT panel fills roughly the left third of the frame and is the SIDE WALL of the room: one plain flat panel in a slightly DARKER shade of pale mint green. One LARGE plain rectangular mirror in a plain dark grey frame hangs ON THIS LEFT SIDE WALL, tall enough to hold a person's head and shoulders, with one plain white pedestal sink standing on the floor directly below it. The mirror and the sink belong to the LEFT side wall only and must NOT be drawn anywhere on the other panel. The RIGHT panel fills the remaining two thirds and is the BACK WALL: one plain flat panel in the lighter pale mint green, completely bare except for one plain white bathtub standing against it at the far right edge. Below both panels, a plain flat white tiled floor runs edge to edge across the bottom of the frame. Exactly one straight diagonal line runs from the foot of the vertical corner line down toward the bottom-left corner of the frame, so the floor plainly reads as turning at the corner. There are no other diagonal lines anywhere in the picture, no vanishing point, and no rows of tiles shrinking toward a distance. The mirror is drawn as a plain EMPTY rectangle with a flat pale blue-white surface crossed by exactly two thin pale white diagonal streak shapes, so it plainly reads as a glass mirror — and absolutely nothing else inside it, no face, no figure, no reflection of the room. The whole middle and right of the tiled floor is left completely clear and empty. Plain flat indoor lighting, daytime.
assets.notes: Thay 'Bob Bathroom V2'. Người dùng xem ảnh V2 và chỉ ra vẫn SAI Ý: V2 chỉ là MỘT mặt tường phẳng, gương dời sang mép trái của chính bức tường đó. Ý muốn là GÓC PHÒNG — có bức tường BÊN TRÁI riêng, gương treo trên bức tường bên ấy (đúng như ảnh tham khảo người dùng gửi). Mô tả bằng hình học (2 mảng phẳng + 1 đường dọc + đúng 1 đường chéo dưới sàn) để có góc mà vẫn không rơi vào phối cảnh hút sâu bị cấm. Người dùng DUYỆT bản có phối cảnh nhẹ này (2026-08-11) vì nhân vật đều là 3/4 view nên nền có chiều sâu mới đặt người vào tự nhiên. Đã chuyển composition sang "corner" — ảnh hiện tại tạo lúc còn là "flat" (mô tả tự thắng được NO_PERSPECTIVE_BLOCK), nếu tạo lại thì "corner" mới đúng và ổn định.

assets.name: Bob Living Room

The sofa and the armchair stand ON the carpet strip and must touch it. Warm muted palette of beige, brown and olive, plain flat indoor lighting, daytime, everything completely dry.

assets.name: Bob Living Room Night

Night palette: everything darker and cooler than a daytime version, lit only by the plain warm yellow lamp. Plain flat indoor lighting, no gradients.

assets.name: Bob Kitchen

The row of cabinets and the countertop must fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge with no gap of bare wall at either side edge.
